subject: Solara Systems: ledger transfer and new invoice liaison
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@solaratech.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@solaratech.com
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Change to payment account and billing contact

Hi Laura / Redwood procurement team,

Quick note to let you know Solara Systems will be changing our receiving bank for invoices starting mid-May. Attached are the signed vendor bank change form, a voided check for the new account, and an updated W-9.

Requested effective date: 2026-05-15 (please do not send payments to the old account after that date).

Attachments: bank_change_form_signed.pdf (PDF), voided_check.png (PNG), w9_updated.pdf (PDF)

If you need any additional verification (your team prefers a legacy remittance notice + test ACH), let me know and I’ll coordinate with our treasury.

Thanks,
Elena Ortiz
Director of Finance Operations
Solara Systems
elena.ortiz@solaratech.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@solaratech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Change to payment account and billing contact

Thanks Elena — received. A couple of quick asks so we can update the vendor record and PO routing cleanly:

- Please confirm the legal entity name on the W-9 exactly matches the name on invoices (we need exact match for ERP).
- We require a completed Vendor Portal Amendment form to change bank details on file; I’ve attached the template.
- Finance typically performs a $0.01 test ACH prior to live payments; will your team accept that? If so, confirm a contact for the test.

Can you return the amendment completed and confirm the legal name? I’ll route to Karthik and Sean for the ERP update and payment cutover scheduling.

Attachments: vendor_portal_amendment.pdf (PDF)

Best,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0124

From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@solaratech.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@solaratech.com
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Change to payment account and billing contact

Hi Laura — thanks for the checklist.

1) Legal entity on W-9: "Solara Systems, Inc." (exact).
2) We’ve completed the Vendor Portal Amendment and signed it; DocuSign envelope here: https://app.docusign.com/solara/bank-amendment/ABC123
3) Yes to the $0.01 test ACH. Please send the test to the new account and CC our treasury alias: accounts@solaratech.com.

Effective date remains 2026-05-15. I’ve attached an additional signed copy of the bank change for your records.

Attachments: bank_change_form_signed.pdf (PDF), vendor_portal_amendment_signed.pdf (PDF)

--
Elena Ortiz
Director of Finance Operations
Solara Systems

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Change to payment account and billing contact

Thanks Elena — I’ll schedule the vendor record update during our change window. Notes for the team:

- I will update the ERP vendor name to exactly "Solara Systems, Inc." and attach the signed W-9 and amendment to the vendor profile.
- PO routing will remain the same; payment account change only.
- Requested cutover: 2026-05-15. We will block invoices dated on/after 2026-05-15 to be paid to the new account.

Sean — can finance confirm the timing for the $0.01 test ACH? I’ll create a short vendor change ticket (VCT-4217) and add the DocuSign reference.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Procurement Specialist
Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick update from payments: we will process a $0.01 ACH test on 2026-05-08 to the new account. Please confirm acceptance once the test clears.

I’ve completed the vendor record change in the ERP (Vendor ID: V-8932). The DocuSign envelope and uploaded attachments are stored in our shared drive: https://drive.redwood.com/records/solara/bank-change-2026-04.

Action items:
- Elena/accounts@solaratech.com: confirm when the $0.01 test posts OK.
- Karthik/Procurement: once confirmed, mark the vendor change ticket VCT-4217 as complete and allow scheduled payments to the new account from invoices dated 2026-05-15 onward.
